title: Linear Vector Contract
objective: Implement ordinary CPython-parseable vector zero/support, pairwise/outer products, norm, and normalization contracts over ZZ QQ and GF(p)

handoff.summary: Added an ordinary CPython-parseable, storage-neutral dense-vector contract for zero/support scans, pairwise products, row-major outer products, p-norms, and non-mutating normalization. Explicit absolute-value, root, and division protocols keep exact/symbolic parent widening under the public integration layer's control. CPython and Sage.js fixtures cover SageMath 10.9.post2 semantics over ZZ, QQ, and GF(7), including finite-field rejection, empty and zero vectors, shape failures, allocation, and preserved source mutability. A five-sample Linux x64 benchmark records length-10,000 support, pairwise product, and norm workloads plus a 100x120 outer product.
risks: This preparation lane intentionally does not expose methods on public Vector, so integration must apply canonical vector coercion before pairwise products and canonical matrix product-parent selection before outer products.

The helper returns flattened outer-product entries because it cannot construct Matrix without importing the high-contention public module; integration must preserve len(left) by len(right) shape, including zero dimensions.

Sage.js currently lacks a public finite-field absolute-value error, so integration must supply a callback that raises ArithmeticError rather than accidentally using the canonical residue's numeric absolute value.
The helper is not yet registered in pyrightconfig.json or the Node test manifest; those are shared integration-lane files.
next_steps: Rebase onto integration commit ba436f6 so src/lib/sagejs/linear_algebra/ has its lazy package owner.
Add src/lib/sagejs/linear_algebra/vector_contract.py to pyrightconfig.json and test/linear-vector-contract.cjs to the Node test manifest.

Wire is_zero, support/nonzero_positions, pairwise_product, outer_product, norm, and normalized onto Vector in src/baselib/matrix.py using canonical coercion/result constructors and without adding a mutating normalize method.
After public wiring, add public Sage differential fixtures for parent identity and consider packed vector kernels only from measured public bottlenecks.
